name: Broccoli Cheddar Sausage Egg Bake
why: Egg + cheddar + heavy-cream bound crustless bake; identity is the custard bake, sausage is a component. Published 463 cal / 25.7g protein / 4.2g carbs sits mid-band on calories, clears the 25g+ protein identity, and is rock-bottom on carbs. Full-fat (not a skinny-lean version), no bread/potato/rice/bean base. Weigh-and-divide casserole, scales cleanly from 8 to 14. Distinct from the sausage-cottage-cheese-egg-bake already in the pool: different binder (heavy cream vs cottage cheese), different veg (broccoli vs spinach), different cheese (cheddar vs colby jack). Every main ingredient maps to the board (breakfast-sausage, broccoli, eggs, heavy-cream, shredded-cheese/cheddar, garlic), so no unmapped flags.
